description: This file defines a PHP class 'I18NLanguageSearchFilterParams' used for specifying search filter parameters related to internationalization languages in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base class 'FilterParams' and includes properties for filtering by enabled status and whether the language was added. It also sets a default sort field.

classes.name: I18NLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering language search results based on enabled status and addition status, with a default sort field set to language name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting the default sort field to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEnabledOnly
methods.description: Returns whether filtering by enabled languages only is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabledOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only enabled languages.

methods.name: getAddedOnly
methods.description: Returns whether filtering by languages that were added only is enabled.

methods.name: setAddedOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only languages that were added.
